title: Wave3 scholarly-transcription mining expansion: Shoju 114-119
purpose: Expand the separate wave3 lane with poem-specific scholarly transcription visible in Yamauchi 1974, preserving strict, orthographic-diagnostic, historical-kana-diagnostic, and unresolved cases as separate classes.

source.author: 山内潤三
source.article: 廻文歌の限界と効用 (下)――高野山釈教長歌を頂点として――

cases.title: 手習子にならひ
cases.visible_transcription_surface: はやもとる さかてくるまか ヱイやらや 家かまるくて かさるともやは
cases.diagnostic_reading_historical_kana: はやもとるさかてくるまかゑいやらやいえかまるくてかさるともやは

cases.reason: The scholarly transcription visibly distinguishes ヱ from 家=いえ. Folding ゑ/え solely to restore symmetry would change the strict historical-kana layer.

cases.title: 寄山恋
cases.visible_transcription_surface: とひつきみ つまとしつ見る たかやまや かたるみつしと まつ身きつひと
cases.conservative_reading: とひつきみつまとしつみるたかやまやかたるみつしとまつみきつひと

safety_rules: Do not repair poem 114 from expected palindrome symmetry.
Do not fold お/を into the strict baseline for poems 115 or 118.
Do not fold ヱ/ゑ and え into the strict baseline for poem 117.
Standard readings of explicit kanji are reading assumptions, not source-furigana evidence.
Raw D/B contacts in poems 116/119 require morphology review before any crossover.
next_action: Audit D=きよ for poem116 versus fixed50 55, and B=つま for poem119 versus fixed50 72; prioritize the latter because both titles are narrow 寄○恋 scenes.
